data.title: Tesla And SpaceX CEO Elon Musk’s $40 Trillion U.S. 'Bankruptcy' Nightmare Is Suddenly Coming True
data.description: Elon Musk, the SpaceX and Tesla chief executive who rode their soaring valuations to become the world’s first trillionaire this year is seeing his $40 trillion U.S. bankruptcy nightmare come true...
data.author: Billy Bambrough
